source.name: Cincinnati Bengals: Cincinnati Bengals and Paycor Announce Stadium Naming Rights Partnership
source.quote: The home of the Cincinnati Bengals is now Paycor Stadium. The Bengals and Cincinnati-based Paycor HCM, Inc. (“Paycor”) (Nasdaq: PYCR) are expanding their partnership to include stadium naming rights

note: Arena naming rights: Paycor Stadium. Start date unknown: the record said 2026 (the season it was recorded), its source is from 2022-08-09.
